name: Baishya
description: Baishya is a young whisperer on Tarkir, twin sister of Naiva and granddaughter of Yasova Dragonclaw, who hears Ugin through the windfolk and the hedrons.

bio.text: Baishya led Naiva up the sacred mountain after a vision, held back an avalanche by shaping the snow into a wall, and received a message from the windfolk for Grandmother.

bio.text: At Ugin's grave she heard the carved headpieces whisper to her, and, saying Ugin was calling her, slipped into the hedron, with Naiva following and falling with her into Ugin's memories.

status.text: As of August 2018 Baishya is alive, having survived Bolas with Yasova, and is charged with Naiva to safeguard memory.

citations.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now

timeline.summary: Naiva and Baishya climb the sacred mountain and hear ticking noises; Baishya says her vision led them there.
timeline.quote: You're too impatient. My vision led me right here, I'm sure of it.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: An avalanche breaks across the Eternal Ice snowfield and buries the twins.
timeline.quote: The snow broke, starting to slide.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya's hands glow green and she shapes the snow into a wall that holds against the avalanche.
timeline.quote: her sister began to mold and shape the crushing snow into a wall in front of them.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Gauzy windfolk emerge from the snow and Baishya faints trying to hear them; Naiva grabs her spear, thinking they are a threat.
timeline.quote: The windfolk came to warn us, not to hurt us.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya says the windfolk called her up to give a message for Grandmother.
timeline.quote: They called me up here to give me a message for Grandmother.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Dragons melt the snow with fire and flood the valley, and Naiva worries what she will do if Grandmother is dead.
timeline.quote: People who wouldn't just turn her twin over to Atarka once they discovered she was a shaman.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: The twins find the hunting party alive on a hill above the flood, and Yasova asks Baishya to report what happened.
timeline.quote: Grandmother was tending to several injured people.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya addresses her grandmother as Yasova Dragonclaw, a name Atarka has banned, and slips into a whisper trance.
timeline.quote: Atarka had banished the name Dragonclaw and eaten every person who had dared use the term in her presence.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya explains the vision came from Ugin and they must go to his grave.
timeline.quote: That's why we have to go to Ugin's grave.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova's party sees an Ojutai dragon hunting on the high plateau, and Yasova decides to avoid it on the way to Ugin's grave.
timeline.quote: I want to reach Ugin's grave without tangling with that dragon.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova praises Naiva and sends her and Baishya to scout a ring of stones where vultures are perched.
timeline.quote: If the vultures are not afraid, then we need not be.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova suspects a trap by Ojutai's broodling but Naiva and Baishya insist she heal him.
timeline.quote: This could be a trap on the part of Ojutai to find me.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya rolls a boulder to block the broodling's ice breath, and Naiva and Yasova kill the aven interpreter with spears.
timeline.quote: Grandmother cast her own spear, and the weapon struck the aven's head for the death blow.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: The broodling shoves aside the boulder as it looms over the twins, but an Atarka broodling slams into it.
timeline.quote: The two beasts went tumbling over the grass, grappling and clawing.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya admits she did not know she could move a rock like that.
timeline.quote: I didn't either,

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova's party camps; at dusk Naiva tells Tae Jin that Yasova brings children to Ugin's grave to wake their magic early.
timeline.quote: Atarka hates magic. She fears it.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin says his master believes some essence of Ugin endures and reached out, which is why he was sent.
timeline.quote: The tempests that birth dragons have increased in strength since Ugin's death.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: The wounded Atarka broodling carries the dead Ojutai dragon to the camp and attacks, calling them traitors.
timeline.quote: Come out! My cousin tells me truth before she dies. Traitor! Dragon killer!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva kills the broodling by driving her spear through its eye.
timeline.quote: Naiva thrust the obsidian point of her spear into the dragon's unblinking eye

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva tends Tae Jin's wound and learns he left his mother at twelve; she reveals Atarka killed her own mother for being a whisperer.
timeline.quote: Our mother is dead. Atarka killed her for being a whisperer.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin argues that keeping the old ways alive defies the dragons, and Naiva realizes she was wrong.
timeline.quote: By keeping them alive, we defy the dragons rather than accept defeat.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin ends his story, and Yasova says she witnessed Ugin's death eighteen years ago and another dragon who vanished in golden light.
timeline.quote: Eighteen years ago, I witnessed a battle in the sky that ended with the death of Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Atarka forces the party to follow her to the corpse and spots Tae Jin as an outsider smelling of Ojutai.
timeline.quote: He smells of Ojutai, that pompous, ice-breathing windbag.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova's party reaches the gateway to Ugin's grave, where hedrons cover the Spirit Dragon's bones, and Yasova calls for the group that camps there.
timeline.quote: Grandmother calls them hedrons. They protect the Spirit Dragon's bones.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova leads the twins through a secret tunnel into a warm hidden sanctuary and then a cavern of whisperer headpieces and carvings.
timeline.quote: They are the garb of a whisperer, as you are meant to be.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells the girls they must become guardians of the carved memories of the ancestors.
timeline.quote: It's past time for you girls to become guardians of this knowledge, so you can pass it on after I am gone.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya hears the headpieces whisper to her, while Naiva feels excluded.
timeline.quote: I hear you,

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: From a hidden cleft the group watches Fec speak with a pregnant woman who resembles Mevra and claims an illness killed the camp.
timeline.quote: An illness ate away their lives and brought them death. I am all that is left.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells the twins she suspects the speaker is not Mevra, orders them to stay hidden, and says to return to Ayagor after a month if she does not come back.
timeline.quote: After a month, return to Ayagor and tell Gerrak he is now First Father of the tribe.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya, saying Ugin is calling her, slips through a narrow cleft and Naiva follows, resisting a whisper telling her to abandon her twin.
timeline.quote: No. Death is more complicated than that. If you won't come, I'm going alone.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva resists a whispered temptation to abandon Baishya and crawls into the hedron after her.
timeline.quote: But duty and love rooted her feet.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva and Baishya fall into Ugin's memories by touching hands inside the hedron.
timeline.quote: The magic of the hedrons opened a gate mind to mind.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva wakes inside the hedron, and Yasova arrives and says Ugin is not dead but trying to communicate through dreams.
timeline.quote: It seems Ugin is not dead after all. But not awake either.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva realizes Bolas does not know where Ugin's body lies and tries to keep him distracted to protect Baishya.
timeline.quote: Somehow, amazingly, this powerful dragon did not know Ugin's body lay concealed beneath the hedrons.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas preys on Naiva's resentments toward Baishya and offers to make her the great hunter and leader.
timeline.quote: You could finally become the great hunter and leader you deserve to be.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva crawls into the hedron, finds Baishya and Yasova, and presses her knife to Baishya's throat.
timeline.quote: Pulling her knife from its sheath, she pressed the blade against Baishya's vulnerable throat.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva, her mind twisted by Bolas, holds a knife to Baishya's throat, then snaps out of it as the hedron's essence reaches her and Yasova disarms her.
timeline.quote: Why was she holding a blade against her sister's throat?

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva takes Baishya's hand and enters Ugin's memories in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: After a decisive nod at Grandmother, she took hold of Baishya's hand.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva and Baishya wake from the memories and tell Yasova what they saw; Yasova decides to surrender herself to Bolas as a desperate gamble.
timeline.quote: The Spirit Dragon has not forgotten Tarkir. We have a chance to deflect Bolas.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova has Baishya wear Naiva's mantle and necklace to meet Bolas in Naiva's place.
timeline.quote: Baishya will wear your mantle and go out in your place.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova and Baishya face Bolas, taunting him that he came back to confirm Ugin was dead.
timeline.quote: You came back to see if he was really dead.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Bolas that the Immortal Sun will trap him and Baishya says they hear the artifact; Bolas, fearing the bluff may be true, strikes the canyon and flees.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun is pointed here, at this very spot on Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva emerges to find the dragon gone and discovers Yasova and Baishya alive, shielded by Baishya's earth magic.
timeline.quote: A big boulder shifted with a great, grinding rumble.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
timeline.quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: The rest of the party arrives; Tae Jin tells Naiva he would never mistake her for her sister again.
timeline.quote: I wouldn't mistake you for your sister ever again.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells the girls they must safeguard memory and asks Tae Jin to stay to recite Ugin's story to Fec for carving.
timeline.quote: I would like you to recite Ugin's story once again to Fec so it can be carved and preserved in more than one place.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova closes by telling the girls that even the greatest of dragons can die and that anything may come to pass in the unwritten now.
timeline.quote: Even the greatest of dragons can die.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

relations.quote: So they would die together as they had been born together, locked in a cold tomb.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

relations.note: Ugin's vision was passed to Baishya through the windfolk
relations.quote: The vision was passed to me by the windfolk but it didn't come from them.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

relations.quote: Grandmother has her reasons for everything she does.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

relations.quote: If Atarka ever suspects you are a whisperer, she'll eat you.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

relations.quote: At least they would die as they had been born: together.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

relations.note: twin sisters who lost their mother to Atarka
relations.quote: Our mother is dead. Atarka killed her for being a whisperer.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

relations.quote: They had been born together, pulled from the bloody womb of their dead mother, hand clasped to hand.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

relations.note: calls Baishya through the hedrons; Baishya is a whisperer who hears him

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

relations.quote: Baishya had always been a burden heavier than a net of dead goblins.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

relations.note: grandmother and granddaughter; Yasova holds Baishya's hand in the hedron
relations.quote: while her right hand grasped Baishya's bare fingers with an affectionate clasp

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

relations.quote: She smiled at her sister's face, twin to her own, the mirror she'd looked into for all of her life.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

pages_say.description: A young whisperer and twin of Naiva who recognizes Tae Jin's words from her vision.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

pages_say.description: A young whisperer who moves a boulder with earth magic to shield Tae Jin and later traps the broodling with a rock.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

pages_say.description: A young whisperer who bonds with Tae Jin over shamanic training.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

pages_say.description: A young whisperer, Naiva's twin, kept close to Yasova.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

pages_say.description: A young whisperer who hears Ugin through the hedron and falls into a trance of visions.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

pages_say.description: A young whisperer in a trance inside the hedron, Naiva's twin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.
